title: Bouncing Ball in a Rotating Hexagon
description: Interactive p5.js simulation demonstrating physics concepts including gravity, momentum, friction, and collision detection with rotating boundaries
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Physics
Mechanics
Collision Detection
Rotational Motion
Kinematics
prerequisites: Basic understanding of forces and motion
learningObjectives: Explain how constant downward gravity and velocity-proportional friction shape the ball's trajectory between collisions
Trace the collision algorithm: projecting the ball onto each hexagon edge, detecting overlap, and reflecting its velocity about the edge normal
Predict how the ball gains or loses kinetic energy when the rotating wall's tangential velocity is added on impact
Compare the ball's behavior at zero, positive (clockwise), and negative (counter-clockwise) rotation speeds using the Speed slider
